blocks.body:
name = "acme/imported-harbor"
version = "1.0.0"
[import.harbor]
trajectory = "trajectory.json"
workdirs = { one = "steps/one/workdir", two = "steps/two/workdir" }

diagnostics.message: [import.harbor] trajectory: Harbor seeds the agent's session with trajectory.json, an ATIF trajectory, before the agent starts; no task.md runtime loads it, so a task.md run starts without that context
[import.harbor] workdirs: before stage one starts, Harbor copies steps/one/workdir/ into the agent's working directory and runs its setup.sh; no task.md runtime does, so the stage starts without them
[import.harbor] workdirs: before stage two starts, Harbor copies steps/two/workdir/ into the agent's working directory; no task.md runtime does, so the stage starts without them
